text:
alyssa: Heads-up — seeing a reconnect spike for a few tenants around 09:14 UTC. Console shows many short SSE connects and a recurring lease id churn pattern.

matt: Which tenants/region? any routing policy overlap?

alyssa: Mostly eu-west-1. Pattern looks like: client sees Keep-Alive=120 -> origin responds Keep-Alive=60 -> client reconnects ~65s later and gets a new lease id. Repeated churn for same user ids.

jordan: Did we flip any edge fast-paths recently? I remember a sticky-lease change last week but not TTL.

sam: Console timeseries is misleading — it groups sessions under one canonical key so churn looks like persistent connections. We might be missing the lease id in UI grouping.

tanya: Can you paste raw request/response headers from a sample? obfuscate keys ok.

alyssa: snippet: 
```
GET /sse/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: inference.redwood.example
X-Tenant: acme-42
X-Session-Lease: lease-7f3b
Keep-Alive: timeout=120
X-Edge-TTL: 120
```

origin -> 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Session-Lease: lease-7f3b
Keep-Alive: timeout=60
```

sam: Origin is clamping to 60 but edge is advertising 120 back to client for some paths — mismatch causes client reconnects and duplicate leases.

matt: Where is authoritative TTL decided? edge config or origin?

jordan: Per design doc origin wins and edge should echo negotiated TTL back to client. If fast-path skips that, we'd see this.

infra-bot: deploy-notice: edge-fast-path rolled out to pool-7 at 2025-11-02T08:23:00Z

alyssa: That rollout time lines up with when this started. Fast-path likely omitted TTL echo. I can repro with curl -H 'X-Tenant: acme-42' -v and see the mismatch on fast-path nodes.

sam: On the console side, grouping logic drops X-Session-Lease and normalizes by tenant only; rapid lease churn is then collapsed and SREs see a stable connection. We should surface lease ids at least when churn > threshold.

tanya: Short-term mitigation: rollback fast-path in eu-west-1 and add console flag to show lease ids in L4/session view for 24h. Also add alert for lease-jitter-rate > 5%.

matt: I can run the rollback canary (pool-3) and then unroll if clean. Who wants to own the console flag? Jordan?

jordan: I’ll open a quick UI patch: add `sessionLease` as a grouping key and a feature flag `ui.showLeaseIds`. Will gate behind env flag and default off.

sam: I'll add a temporary metric/alert: `lease_jitter_rate` per region tenant. If >5% for 5m, page eng-platform and eng-sre.

matt: Running canary on pool-3 now.

alyssa: Thanks — can you post fast-path rollback command/pod list?

infra-bot: playbook: rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/edge-fast-path --namespace=edge --to-revision=1` ; canary: run against label pool=3 first.

matt: Canary pool-3 looks stable after 3m, no reconnect spike. Proceeding to rollback pool-7 in eu-west-1.

alyssa: Once rollback is live, we'll monitor reconnect rate and lease churn for 30m, then draft incident note in incidents/. We'll also add a unit test asserting edge echoes origin TTL and an e2e that exercises rapid lease churn grouping in console.

tanya: I’ll prepare the console patch draft and a follow-up retro card. :thumbsup:

sam: Also adding a short integration test for handshake TTL negotiation in proxy tests, and a console integration that verifies grouping includes `sessionLease` when the flag is set.

alyssa: Filing incident doc now. Thanks everyone for the quick coordination.

infra-bot: alert-created: lease-jitter-rate (eu-west-1) threshold=5% owners=[eng-platform,eng-sre]
